ضِمَامَةٌ : see إِضْمَامَةٌ. ―
-b2- ضِمَامَتَا المُصْحَفِ means The two sides [or boards] of the book, that embrace it between them. (T and M and TA voce دَفَّةٌ.) And in like manner, ضِمَامَتَا السَّرْجِ and الرَّحْل [The two boards of the horse's saddle and of the camel's saddle, that embrace it between them]. (M ibid.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
